title: from_credentials panic message omits $2x$ but code allows it
description: The panic message in from_credentials() says 'must start with $2a$, $2b$, or $2y$' but the code also accepts $2x$ (a bug-era OpenBSD variant). If an operator passes a $2x$ hash: (1) the panic does not fire, (2) the user gets silently rejected at auth time because the bcrypt crate likely does not support $2x$. The message is misleading for operators reading the panic text. Either remove $2x$ from the allowed set or add it to the panic message.
